hero.message: I'm a computer science engineer, currently working as a technical leader specialist / software developer. Always searching to improve my career with projects based on technologies I have extensive experience in, with new challenges and a friendly work environment, preferring remote positions.

about.p1: I'm Iván Pastor Simarro, a technical leader specialist / software developer with a backend profile. I have experience with PHP (Laravel, Symfony), Java (Spring) and Vue.js, and I enjoy building projects from design to production.
about.p2: Outside of work I play piano and synths, and in recent years I've been travelling, especially interested in Japanese culture.
